title: Location Disclosure
description: The child's device transmits live GPS coordinates, which could be intercepted by unauthorized parties, leading to potential tracking of the child's location.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: The live GPS coordinates being transmitted could be intercepted during transmission, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive location data.

title: Data Misuse by Backend
description: The backend may store or process the GPS coordinates in a way that could lead to unauthorized access or misuse of the child's location data.

title: Data Disclosure through Location Pings
description: The backend process writes location pings to the Location History Store, which may lead to the disclosure of personal location data. This could happen either explicitly (intended sharing) or implicitly (through metadata or derived data).

title: Data Disclosure in Location History Store
description: The Location History Store may retain location data that could be accessed by unauthorized parties, leading to potential data disclosure. This is particularly concerning if the data is not adequately protected or if access controls are insufficient.

title: Data Disclosure through Location Sharing
description: The mobile app backend forwards location pings to the Geofencing Engine, which may lead to the unintended disclosure of users' location data to unauthorized parties if proper access controls are not in place.

title: Inadequate Information Handling
description: The Geofencing & Alert Engine may process location data in a way that does not adequately protect user privacy, potentially leading to unauthorized access or misuse of personal data.

title: Unauthorized Access to Family Account
description: There is a risk that unauthorized users may gain access to the Family Account & Permissions Store, leading to potential misuse of sensitive family location data.

title: Inadequate Data Handling Practices
description: The Geofencing & Alert Engine may not handle the retrieved zone definitions securely, leading to potential exposure of sensitive location data.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The Geofencing & Alert Engine may retain location data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Inadequate Consent Management
description: The Geofencing Engine may not have obtained proper consent from the child or parent for tracking their location, leading to potential legal and ethical issues.

title: Insecure Data Handling
description: The parent may mishandle the arrival/departure notifications, leading to unauthorized access or sharing of sensitive location data.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The parent may retain the location data longer than necessary, violating data minimization principles and increasing the risk of exposure.

title: Inadequate Consent Mechanism
description: The parent may not fully understand what data is being collected or how it will be used when registering an account and creating the child's profile, leading to a lack of informed consent.

title: Data Misuse
description: The mobile app backend may misuse the child's profile data (name, DOB, school) for purposes other than intended, such as marketing or sharing with third parties without consent.

title: Unintended Data Exposure
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently expose sensitive information about the child (e.g., name, DOB, school) through inadequate security measures or data leaks.

title: Data Disclosure from Mobile App Backend
description: The Mobile App Backend (Process) may unintentionally disclose personal data (account, child profile, geofence zone data) to unauthorized parties during the storage process.

title: Data Disclosure in Family Account & Permissions Store
description: The Family Account & Permissions Store (DataStore) may expose personal data to unauthorized access or sharing when processing or storing the data.

title: Inadequate Consent
description: The parent may not have provided explicit consent for the mobile app to access the child's location data, leading to a potential violation of privacy rights.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The mobile app backend may store the child's location data insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Data Misuse
description: The mobile app backend may misuse the child's location data for purposes other than what was originally intended or disclosed to the parent.

title: Location Data Leakage
description: The location history stored in the DataStore may be accessed by unauthorized processes or users, leading to potential leakage of sensitive location data.

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The Mobile App Backend may not have adequate access controls in place, allowing unauthorized access to the retrieved location history data.

title: Data Misuse
description: The Mobile App Backend may misuse the retrieved location history data for purposes other than intended, such as selling or sharing with third parties without consent.

title: Linkability Threat
description: The parent sharing the child's location with a secondary guardian may lead to linkability threats if the secondary guardian can be identified through the shared data, potentially allowing them to link the child's location with other data sources.

title: Informed Consent Threat
description: The mobile app backend may process the shared location data without ensuring that the secondary guardian is fully informed about the implications of accessing this data, leading to potential privacy violations.

title: Data Disclosure Threat
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently disclose the child's location data to unauthorized parties if proper access controls are not implemented.

title: Unintended Use Threat
description: The secondary guardian may use the child's location data for purposes other than intended, such as tracking the child without the parent's consent.

title: Location Data Leakage
description: The mobile app backend shares the child's live location with the secondary guardian, which could lead to unauthorized access or exposure of sensitive location data if the secondary guardian's device is compromised or misused.

title: Insecure Interaction with Secondary Guardian
description: The secondary guardian may interact with the received location data insecurely, potentially leading to unauthorized sharing or misuse of the child's location information.

title: Data Misuse by Secondary Guardian
description: The secondary guardian may misuse the child's location data for purposes other than intended, such as tracking the child without consent or sharing the data with third parties.

title: Loss of Control over Personal Data
description: The mobile app backend shares aggregated usage and engagement analytics with an external advertising/analytics partner, which may lead to loss of control over how this data is used or further shared by the partner.

title: Inadequate Information Handling by External Entity
description: The advertising/analytics partner may inadequately handle the aggregated analytics data, leading to potential misuse or unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Data Misuse by External Entity
description: The external entity may misuse the aggregated data for purposes not disclosed to the users, such as targeted advertising without consent.

title: Attributable data evidence
description: The SOS message sent by the child can be attributed to the child, potentially exposing their location and identity to unauthorized parties.

title: Insecure data handling
description: The mobile app backend may not securely handle the received SOS message, leading to potential exposure of the child's location and identity.

title: Linkability of data
description: The SOS message may be linked to the child's identity, allowing for tracking or profiling by unauthorized entities.
